mapper.select: SELECT pm.member_id, pm.user_id, su.real_name, pm.member_role FROM project_member pm JOIN sys_user su ON su.user_id = pm.user_id AND su.is_deleted = 0 WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY CASE pm.member_role WHEN 'leader' THEN 1 WHEN 'advisor' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, pm.member_id ASC
